culture-cycles.note: State holidays only; the nine nationwide holidays (in 2027: 1 Jan, 26 and 29 Mar, 1 May, 6 and 17 May, 3 Oct, 25 and 26 Dec) are on Germany's record. Several 2027 dates fall on a weekend, and there is no substitute weekday.

laws.rule: Hannover charges an accommodation tax per adult guest per night by price band: nothing up to EUR 25, EUR 3 up to EUR 50, EUR 4 up to EUR 100 (about A$6.36, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), then EUR 1 more for each further EUR 50 or part, capped at EUR 12; breakfast and parking are not counted.
